modmenu.descriptionTranslation.illuminat: Unofficial continuation of Illuminations: fireflies, glowworms, plankton and other ambient lights for dark places. Client-side only. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ladysnake.
config.illuminations_reimagined.title: Illuminations Reimagined
Turns every effect from this mod on or off.
Scales how often every effect spawns. 100% is the default; 0% stops new effects from appearing.
config.illuminations_reimagined.spawnRad: How far from you effects may appear. Larger values spread the same number of effects over a wider area.
config.illuminations_reimagined.samplesP: Spots checked for possible effects each tick. Higher fills the world faster but costs a little more performance.
config.illuminations_reimagined.maxCount: No more than this many of this effect exist at the same time.
config.illuminations_reimagined.fireflie: Fireflies also appear during the day instead of only at night.
Fireflies may also appear in caves below eligible biomes.
Fireflies drift toward nearby light sources they can see, such as torches and lanterns.
Every firefly gets a random colour instead of its biome's colour.
Orange fireflies. "In October" follows your computer's date.
Brightness of the white centre of each firefly.
config.illuminations_reimagined.glowworm: No more than this many glowworms exist at the same time. Where they appear is set per biome in Biome Settings.
config.illuminations_reimagined.plankton: No more than this many plankton specks exist at the same time. Where they appear is set per biome in Biome Settings.
config.illuminations_reimagined.eyes.mod: Glowing eyes in pitch-black places. "In October" follows your computer's date.
config.illuminations_reimagined.eyes.rat: How often eyes appear when they are active.
config.illuminations_reimagined.wisps.so: How often wisps rise from soul sand and soul soil in Soul Sand Valleys.
config.illuminations_reimagined.wisps.fr: Wisps occasionally drift out of soul lanterns.
Pumpkin spirits and poltergeists, at night only. "In October" follows your computer's date.
Spirits slip out of jack o'lanterns.
Poltergeists sometimes escape from undead mobs that die at night.
config.illuminations_reimagined.chorus.m: How many petals drift from chorus flowers. ×0 turns them off.
config.illuminations_reimagined.chorus.b: Breaking a chorus flower releases a burst of petals.
config.illuminations_reimagined.prismari: Crystals float in the water around sea lanterns.
No more than this many crystals exist at the same time.
config.illuminations_reimagined.biome.fi: How often fireflies appear here at night.
config.illuminations_reimagined.biome.gl: How often glowworms appear on cave ceilings here.
config.illuminations_reimagined.biome.pl: How often plankton appears in dark water here.
